raw_response: In July, visitors can enjoy a cluster of iconic sites in precinct 22, where attractions such as Gapstow Bridge, Central Park Carousel, Central Park Zoo, Delacorte Musical Clock, Bow Bridge, Bethesda Fountain, Blockhouse No. 1, Central Park, Cleopatra’s Needle and the Metropolitan Museum of Art each report an average of 37.7 incidents. The area offers a range of nearby lodging, with 49 hotels within 1 km of Gapstow Bridge and 37 within 1 km of both the Carousel and the Zoo, while the cheapest nightly rate among these options is $70.0 near Blockhouse No. 1 and $101.0 for several other sites. For travelers who prefer to stay in a precinct with many attractions and several budget‑friendly hotels, precinct 10 provides 138 attractions, an average of 394.0 reported incidents, 3 budget hotels and a median nightly price of $134.0. Precinct 5 follows with 76 attractions, an average of 415.3 reported incidents, 7 budget hotels and a median nightly price of $163.0, offering a slightly larger selection of affordable rooms. If you are willing to pay a bit more for a central location, precinct 1 hosts 129 attractions, reports 761.0 incidents on average, and has 1 budget hotel with a median nightly rate of $196.0. Precincts 90 and 20 also provide solid options, with 56 and 29 attractions respectively, average incidents of 553.7 and 349.7, 2 and 3 budget hotels, and median nightly rates of $173.0 and $174.0.
